errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in 1%-Intervallen angegeben sind
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels are shown at intervals of 2 percentage points (e.g., 7, 9, 11), not 1% as stated.
The description states the blue line ends at approximately 6.4% in 2024, but the chart shows this value to be approximately 3.5%.

errors.text_span: mit einem Tiefpunkt von etwa 2,7% im Jahr 2014
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies 2014 as the low point for the blue line. The actual low point occurs in 2013 at approximately 3%. In 2014, the value is approximately 5%.
The description states the purple line ends at approximately 2.2% in 2024, but the chart shows this value to be just above 1%.

errors.text_span: mit einem Tiefpunkt von etwa -0,8% im Jahr 2009
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies 2009 as the low point for the purple line with a value of -0.8%. The actual lowest point is in 2014 at approximately -0.5%. The value in 2009 was positive, around 1.5%.
